traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet. This combination is modern/cyclic only.

modern.blend: Feelings meet imagination and dissolution. A need for escape and reverie, high sensitivity, and compassion.
modern.harmonious: Imaginative and receptive; help seems to arrive from others.
modern.hard: Emotional boundaries dissolve, leaving you drained by others or lost in daydream.
modern.business: Strong for imaginative work; protect boundaries and energy.

cyclicNote: This pair runs a full conjunction-to-conjunction cycle; waxing/waning phase meaning is carried on the transit entries.
